paragraphs: Swarnasky started with one goal: build technology that makes a real difference for the people who use it. We bring together strong engineers and designers to solve the complex problems most teams walk away from.

Today we're the technology partner behind leading insurers — across home, auto, pet, and flood cover — with AI-driven tools that automate the work that used to slow you down. Bring us your hardest problem; that's the part we like best.

sections.heading: Anuradha
section_path: We build the technology that moves your business forward.
Meet the team behind our success.
paragraphs: " When you work with Swarnasky, you're never just another project. My promise to every client is simple — we treat your toughest challenges as our own, and we don't rest until we've delivered technology you can truly rely on. Behind every product we build is a team that genuinely cares, and that's the difference our clients feel from day one "

"An experienced technology leader specializing in PHP application development and software architecture. Dedicated to delivering secure, scalable, and client-focused solutions while fostering technical excellence across the team."
"Keeping delivery smooth and the team moving in one direction. Fostering cross-departmental collaboration."

"Building high-performance, cross-platform mobile applications with a focus on innovation, usability, and seamless user experiences. Passionate about creating scalable, responsive, and visually engaging apps that deliver exceptional performance across Android and iOS."

"Our Business Analysts bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions. They collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements, analyze business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate business goals into clear functional requirements. By ensuring effective communication between clients and development teams, they help deliver high-quality solutions that drive business growth and operational efficiency."
"Transformed business needs into clear, actionable requirements to support efficient project delivery and enhanced user experiences."

"A seasoned PHP and Laravel developer with expertise in building secure, scalable, and high-performance web applications. Passionate about clean architecture, API development, and backend optimization, delivering reliable solutions that drive business growth and exceptional user experiences."

"Leading the development of scalable, high-performance applications while mentoring teams to deliver innovative software solutions. Passionate about Python development, clean architecture, and building reliable systems that drive business success."

"Leading quality assurance with a strong focus on precision, reliability, and continuous improvement. Passionate about ensuring every product is thoroughly tested, delivering seamless user experiences and building confidence through uncompromising quality."

"Ensuring the highest standards of accuracy and quality across every stage of the billing process. Dedicated to leading quality assurance initiatives, improving operational efficiency, and delivering reliable, compliant billing solutions that clients can trust."
